hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s re-election bid and economic defense
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei launched aggressive public defenses of his free-market economic plan while officially announcing his candidacy for re-election in 2027. He convened high-intensity strategy meetings with legislators, rejected government aid for indebted citizens, and unleashed profane tirades against journalists criticizing his policies.
hotspots.affect: Combative presidential rhetoric and open attacks on the press create intense ideological polarization and high moral drama surrounding Argentina's economic trajectory.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: With state elections approaching in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, the Alternative for Germany (AfD) is polling above 40%, raising the prospect of its first state premiership. Public broadcasters MDR and NDR staged unprecedented broadcast blackouts to warn voters that an AfD victory could lead to the shutdown of public media contracts.
hotspots.affect: The prospect of an explicit far-right government in Germany triggers existential alarms regarding democratic institutions, press freedom, and public broadcasting.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s visa and immigration crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has escalated its immigration agenda by announcing plans to revoke up to 200,000 business and tourist visas from asylum seekers and proposing a $103,000 fee for H-1B visas. Global consular visa appointments have been temporarily halted for public charge training, sparking widespread panic among foreign workers and international applicants.
hotspots.affect: Rapid, punitive policy changes and high monetary barriers provoke urgent fear, outrage, and severe economic uncertainty among immigrant communities.

hotspots.title: Italy’s Salvini pushes budget deficit and fuel tax battles
hotspots.blurb: Italian Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini is demanding a €20 billion budget deficit increase without European Union approval to fund stalled infrastructure and extend fuel tax cuts. His calls to tax extra profits of major banks and energy corporations have exposed deepening rift lines within Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's ruling coalition.
hotspots.affect: Escalating fiscal defiance against EU constraints combined with internal coalition warfare creates intense anxiety over national financial stability.

hotspots.title: Trump administration threatens Kennedy Center demolition
hotspots.blurb: The Justice Department and Trump administration officials have warned in court filings that the historic John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts could face demolition if legal challenges halt ongoing renovation and renaming plans. The administration argues the building is structurally unsound, proposing to replace it with an open-air amphitheater.
hotspots.affect: Threatening a landmark national cultural icon provokes visceral outrage and symbolic cultural confrontation across the political spectrum.
